Overview

Maracay is a city in D with a population of 1,000,000. The Garden City of Venezuela, a planned city with wide boulevards, parks, and a historic bullring. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
